# Ground

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/components/rigid_body.h`](../../../src/logic/components/rigid_body.h) · Scene / prefab name: `Ground` · Described in `data/core.json`

Flat ground: a static box whose top face is at top_y, centred on x = z = 0, STATIC layer

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `size` | `glm::vec3` | full extents (150, 10, 150), must be positive |
| `top_y` | `float` | height of the top face (0) |
| `friction` | `float` | 1 |
| `restitution` | `float` | 0 |
| `body` | `uint32_t` | JPH::BodyID, 0xffffffff until created |

## Notes

Created by RigidBodySys in init and on later ticks; removed with the component.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: AgentFactory, Rewards, WorldView. Written by: PlayerSpawn, RigidBody. Created by: PlayerSpawn. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [AgentFactory](../systems/AgentFactory.md) | system | World | **read** | reset (applySlope) | The flat ground boxes whose static Jolt bodies are tilted for the episode. |
| [PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | preinit | with `ground: true`: a new entity with a 1200 x 10 x 1200 m Ground (top at y = 0), before RigidBody's init makes the grounds |
| [Rewards](../systems/Rewards.md) | system | World | **read** | reset (applySlope) | The flat ground boxes whose static Jolt bodies are tilted for the episode. |
| [RigidBody](../systems/RigidBody.md) | system | Both | **readwrite** | init, tick (createGrounds), finish, destroyGround | static box made, body id written / reset |
| [WorldView](../systems/WorldView.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick (world registries) | created grounds: a box of size, top at top_y |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[AgentFactory](../systems/AgentFactory.md)**
  - Reads resources/<body> and resources/<params> and hashes them (SHA-256); throws AssetError on a malformed file.
  - Creates 16 Jolt bodies and, for a dynamic walker, 15 swing-twist constraints with motors; removes them at finish.
  - Moves the static Ground bodies at every episode start (slope) and sets the segments' poses, velocities and mass properties.
  - Creates the drawn shape entities when draw is set; they live as long as the world.
  - Logs errors without a HumanBotSpawn entity or with WalkRoutes but no ground field, a warning when no spawn point is found in the slope band.
- **[PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md)**
  - Creates entities: the player (and its two hands for VR) and `props` box entities in init; one Ground entity in preinit with `ground: true`.
  - No physics bodies itself: RigidBody (a later system) makes the Jolt bodies of the RigidBody components it adds.
- **[Rewards](../systems/Rewards.md)**
  - At a reset: the walker's and the Ground boxes' Jolt bodies are moved and mass properties changed; logs a warning when no spawn point is found in the slope band.
- **[RigidBody](../systems/RigidBody.md)**
  - Creates, adds, removes and destroys Jolt bodies; OptimizeBroadPhase after static geometry is added.
  - Connects on_destroy<RigidBody>, on_destroy<Ground>, on_destroy<HeightField> (disconnected in finish and the destructor).
  - Log warnings on invalid shapes, invalid height fields and when Jolt is out of bodies.
- **[WorldView](../systems/WorldView.md)**
  - Uploads generated capsule meshes to the GPU through ModelManager::add (Transfer), once per size.
  - Creates and destroys host entities as bodies appear and go; destroys all of them in finish.
